item.title: Largest Context Window Open-Source LLMs (Local, 2026)
item.description: The largest context window open-source LLM as of November 2026 is Llama 4 Scout, with 10M tokens. A wider group supports about 1M: Llama 4 Maverick, Kimi K3 and the new Kimi K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4, GLM-5.3, MiniMax-M3, Mistral Large 4 and Meta’s Muse Spark Open. Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 run 262,144 tokens natively. Running any of them at full length locally is limited by GPU memory, not the model card.
